Sprint Name: HeySales Studio> Custom Scorecards - Simulation creation
Test Case Title: TC0009_ Check deleting the default scorecard
Description: Validate When a default scorecard is deleted, the simulations to which the scorecard is tagged should not be affected. After the default scorecard is deleted system should make the paperflite scorecard as default
Precondition: Simulation should be assigned to 5 learners and 2 learners should complete the call
Steps:
1. Open scorecard X, make it default
2. Create 2 simulation
3. Assign it to 5 learners
4. As learner [A and B], complete the simulation
5. As admin delete the scorecard X
6. Check the UI of scorecards in settings
Expected Result:
1. Admin should be able to make scorecard X as default
2. Admin should be able to create a simulation and scorecard X should be the tagged scorecard for the simulation
3. Admin should be able to add learners to the simulation
4. Learners shoudl be able to start the simulation and complete. The generated report should be based on scorecard X
5. Admin should be able to delete the scorecard X
6. When a default scorecard is deleted, the simulations to which the scorecard is tagged should not be affected. After the default scorecard is deleted system should make the paperflite scorecard as default
Actual Result: When a default scorecard is deleted, the simulations to which the scorecard is tagged are not affected. After the default scorecard is deleted the system makes the paperflite scorecard as default
